headline: No Name climbs from 594th to 53rd on ARC-2

sections.text: No Name gained 20.00 to 51.39, moving from 594th to 53rd on the ARC-AGI-2 public board. The jump puts the team inside the top 100. Tufa Labs leads the board at 88.06.
